title: PIXL 8000 Purple Dream Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Purple Dream is a bold blend of juicy Grape and a medley of Mixed Berries, offering a rich and slightly tangy fruit vape. It’s smooth, vibrant, and packed with flavour. Prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and supplied with a 10ml refill reservoir, this pod works exclusively with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. The setup delivers up to 8000 puffs with consistently smooth vapour thanks to mesh coil tech. Draw-activated for MTL vaping with Boost Mode available, Purple Dream is a great option for fruit lovers who enjoy a deeper, more rounded vape.
